design.decision: Lead [♦] honors to cash them, and once your team is void, trump [♦] leads instead of discarding, which pulls the Suits and Spades plans together.
design.opponent: Shown on the first such win; opponents stop leading [♦] and duck [♦] tricks they would otherwise contest.
design.rationale: Uncommon and common versions pay flat amounts; at rare this compounds per event. The led-suit filter rewards both cashing [♦] and ruffing it, so the [♦] line has two ways to score and is not killed by voids.
design.draftText: ×1.3 contract multiplier when your team wins a trick led with [♦]

critic.concerns: Per-event compounding ×mult is hard to track; otherwise a clean step up from ua-diamond-led-win-mult and ca-diamond-led-win.
